data.title: BRANDING.md + 90s-slick demo HTML artifact for drawing software

data.body: REVIEW (cold, fresh context): Read plan, BRANDING.md, and demo/pattern-maker-demo.html in full. Verified: (1) all 11 brand tokens + #106B60 dot-grid hex values match exactly between BRANDING.md and the demo :root block; extra demo hexes are the 16 drawing swatches (delegated to demo by BRANDING sec.3) and one derived button-hover. (2) Script body passes node --check. (3) All 14 getElementById targets and every querySelector target (incl. all 8 keyboard-mapped data-tool values) exist in markup. (4) Logic hand-checked: symmetry matrices fix the canvas center (mirror det = -1, true reflection; 8x = 4 rotations x mirror), scanline flood fill is bounds-guarded with seed==target early-out and re-guarded symmetric fill points, undo snapshots before every stroke/fill/clear (capped 30), shape preview restore correct, pointer pos scaling correct, pointercancel handled. (5) No external resources (only URL-ish hit is internal toDataURL). (6) Explicit backgrounds everywhere; single-theme-by-choice per plan. (7) No horizontal overflow at narrow widths: palettebar wraps, toolrail auto-fills, easel min-width:0, status grow cell overflow:hidden. BRANDING.md is self-consistent, has concrete hex/type/bevel/voice specs and references the demo (sec.11). ONE trivial finding, fixed inline: straight apostrophe '96 in three spots (title tag, CSS comment, window aria-label) violated BRANDING sec.2 typographic-apostrophe rule; corrected all three. VERDICT: PASS - meets all acceptance criteria; moving to done.
